blind_spot: 2026-10-04 — decode_ratio counts RDKit-PARSEABLE decodes; it does NOT measure chemistry. MEASURED on 24 real Ru complexes: with the bond head predicting BOND_NO_BOND for nearly every pair the metric read 0.977 (a decoder emitting each atom as its own fragment gives 'C.C.C.C', which MolFromSmiles + SanitizeMol accept); once the head learned real bond classes it FELL to 0.219. The metric is therefore ANTI-CORRELATED with correctness over the range that mattered, and a value near 1.000 here is evidence the model learned nothing. It must not be read, quoted, or gated on as a decoder-quality result. Use metrics/by_metric/cfm_bond_accuracy.json (bond F1 / precision / recall vs the corpus Wiberg truth) as the CFM bond-quality metric, and read the gen_* chemistry fields (largest_fragment_frac, single_fragment_ratio, metal_ratio) beside any generation-validity number.
